item.title: The Coming War on Memory and Storage: How Much VRAM, RAM, and Disk Will You Need in the Next Two Years?
item.description: Based on real experience running a 14B model on a 4070 SUPER 12G, this post looks at how local AI hardware requirements will evolve over the next 1-2 years and what ordinary users should upgrade.
